title: erodium triangulare var. affine
intro: Erodium triangulare var. affine, commonly known as the Red-stemmed Geranium, is a plant species within the Geraniaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include relief from inflammation, pain, and fever, as well as its ability to act as a diuretic and laxative. The health benefits of Red-stemmed Geranium include its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce oxidative stress and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects.
